A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully expressed three CYP2A variants, two CYP4A variants, and two CYP2D variants in COS7 mammalian cells and have shown their expressions in COS7 cells by immunoblots.
the expression levels of the CYP2A, CYP4A, and CYP2D variants in COS-7 were different and that the expression of CYP2D1*1 and CYP2A1*1 variants were higher than that of CYP4A1*1 and other variants.

the CYP variants can be expressed in COS-7 cell line and can be used for further studies.
the relative level of expression of P450 variants in a mammalian cell line may be an important factor for functional differences of P450 variants and drug responses.
